about: Practice set, written by the app's author and used while building (prompt wording, answer format, speed). It is NOT the test set: accuracy is reported only on pnt.json and everyday.json, whose clues were written by someone who had not seen the prompts. Words that also appear in those two sets are dropped by scripts/eval.mjs when this file is run.
